headerDisplay: Nothing to fill in here to get started. Run `smartlife-light setup` once in the Terminal to link your Smart Life account: your lights are then found automatically. The list below is only for renaming a light, pinning its IP address or adding extra controls.

devices.title: Lights (optional)
devices.description: Leave empty unless you need one of the options below.

ip.title: IP address
ip.description: Leave empty: the light is found automatically, even if its address changes.

key.title: Local key
key.description: Only to add a light that the setup did not save: 16 characters.

version.title: Protocol version
version.description: Leave on automatic unless the light cannot connect.

extras.title: Extra controls
extras.description: Features of the lamp beyond light, such as a rotation speed or a star switch. Known lamps (star projectors) get theirs automatically: use this to rename or hide them, or to add your own. `smartlife-light watch <light>` shows which data point does what.

type.title: Type
type.description: Switch: on/off. Light: on/off with an intensity. Fan: a speed. All: one switch for the whole lamp.

oneOf.title: All (master switch, data point = main power)

brightnessDp.title: Intensity data point
brightnessDp.description: Light only: the data point holding the intensity.

min.title: Lowest value
min.description: Light intensity or fan speed range. Fan: the value that means stopped.

powerOn.title: Also switch the lamp on
powerOn.description: For lamps whose features only work while they are on: switching this on first powers the lamp on, and it is shown as off while the lamp is off.
